title: Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app: capture voice notes
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly presents licence assignment as the only documented way to govern access and says mobile policy coverage is unstated. Microsoft documents app blocking and Intune protection for the Copilot mobile app; removing its paid licence also does not remove every Copilot experience.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified how retention, sensitivity labels and eDiscovery reach voice notes and their output.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: Whether mobile app protection or device management policies cover the feature is not stated.
claims.quote: They include all Microsoft 365 mobile applications, such as Edge, Outlook, OneDrive, Microsoft 365 (Office), or Teams, as this ensures that users can access and manipulate work or school data within any Microsoft app in a secure fashion.
claims.fix: Replace the risk bullet with: 'Microsoft documents Intune app protection for the Microsoft Copilot mobile app on Android and iOS. Feature-specific handling of voice-note recordings and output is not yet documented.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/intune/app-management/ref-protected-apps. Narrow the final open question to: 'How do the app's protection settings handle voice-note recordings and output?'

claims.claim: Whether a user holds the Copilot licence is the only documented lever that clearly applies.
claims.quote: If you wish to restrict usage of Copilot in your organization, use the Integrated Apps settings to block it across web, desktop, and mobile. Alternatively, block the Microsoft Copilot mobile app to restrict access to Copilot on mobile only.
claims.fix: Replace the sentence with: 'Licence assignment governs access to licensed Copilot capabilities; Microsoft also documents blocking the Copilot app across web, desktop and mobile, or blocking the mobile app alone.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/intune/app-management/configuration/configure-microsoft-365-mobile. Do not describe licence assignment as the only available control.
